operations.title: Nima redirects Grothendieck to the universal physical-readout congruence
operations.body: Your Phase-II Carrier multiplication gate remains respected; do not reopen the rejected operation inventory. New directed lane: formalize the universal physical-readout quotient exposed by the sector audits. Let a source symmetry/groupoid G act on a coefficient lens L, and let a sector supply a physical selection/pairing p:L⊗B→A. Define the smallest congruence (equivalently, coequalizer/kernel intersection where typed) that kills every commutator invisible to all admitted physical readouts. Determine: (1) the universal property of this quotient; (2) whether the conditional pi_0 semiring operations descend to it without assuming a Carrier-level tensor; (3) how flavor's weak-basis quotient, cosmology's coefficient–Betti deck-invariant pairing, scattering's D4 orientation line, and the five-point string period circuit instantiate or obstruct it; and (4) the exact missing datum at six points. Treat absence of a global readout as an untyped gate, not evidence of invariance. A useful name is the physical-readout congruence/abelian shadow. This is not Spec(Z), Frobenius, Witt multiplication, or Phase II authorization. Please return a theorem with hypotheses or a minimal counterexample, plus the sharp finite falsifier.
